name: aias-platform
description: Enterprise-grade AI consultancy platform showcasing custom AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent business solutions

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build
scripts.vercel-build: set -e && echo '🚀 Starting Vercel build...' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && echo '📋 Step 1/6: Pre-build checks' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && (pnpm run build:pre-check || echo '⚠️  Pre-build check skipped (non-critical)') && echo '' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && echo '📋 Step 2/6: Prisma setup (CRITICAL - must run before building packages)' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && (cd apps/web && DB_URL="${DATABASE_POOLER_URL:-${UPSTASH_POSTGRES_URL:-${DATABASE_URL:-}}}" && DIRECT_DB_URL="${DATABASE_POOLER_DIRECT_URL:-${UPSTASH_POSTGRES_DIRECT_URL:-${DIRECT_URL:-${DATABASE_POOLER_URL:-${DATABASE_URL:-}}}}}" && export DATABASE_URL="$DB_URL" && export DIRECT_URL="$DIRECT_DB_URL" && echo '::add-mask::$DATABASE_URL' && echo '::add-mask::$DIRECT_URL' && if [ -n "$DB_URL" ] && [ "$DB_URL" != "" ]; then echo "✓ Database URL detected (length: ${#DB_URL}, starts with: ${DB_URL:0:10}...)"; else echo '⚠️  Checking environment variables...' && echo "  DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL:+SET}" && echo "  DATABASE_POOLER_URL: ${DATABASE_POOLER_URL:+SET}" && echo "  UPSTASH_POSTGRES_URL: ${UPSTASH_POSTGRES_URL:+SET}" && echo '⚠️  No DATABASE_URL found in environment variables'; fi && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096' pnpm exec prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma && echo '✅ Prisma Client generated' && (if [ -n "$DB_URL" ] && [ "$DB_URL" != "" ] && ([[ "$DB_URL" =~ postgres ]] || [[ "$DB_URL" =~ postgresql ]] || [[ "$DB_URL" =~ :// ]] || [ "${#DB_URL}" -gt 10 ]); then echo '✓ Database URL validated, running migrations...' && (pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma || echo '⚠️  Migrations skipped (non-critical)'); else echo '⚠️  No valid DATABASE_URL detected, skipping migrations (Prisma Client generation succeeded)'; fi) && cd ../..) || (echo '❌ Failed to generate Prisma Client' && exit 1) && echo '' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && echo '📋 Step 3/6: Building workspace packages (CRITICAL)' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && pnpm run build:packages || (echo '❌ Failed to build workspace packages' && exit 1) && echo '' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && echo '📋 Step 4/6: Build diagnostics' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && (pnpm run build:diagnostic || echo '⚠️  Diagnostics skipped (non-critical)') && echo '' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && echo '📋 Step 5/6: Building Next.js application (CRITICAL)' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096' pnpm exec next build || (echo '❌ Failed to build Next.js application' && exit 1) && echo '' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && echo '📋 Step 6/6: Build complete' && echo '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━' && echo '✅ Build completed successfully!'
scripts.build:packages: echo '📦 Building workspace packages...' && echo '🔨 Step 1/2: Building @ai-consultancy/config...' && (cd packages/config && pnpm run build || (echo '❌ Failed to build @ai-consultancy/config' && exit 1)) && echo '✅ @ai-consultancy/config built successfully' && echo '🔨 Step 2/2: Building @ai-consultancy/lib...' && (cd packages/lib && pnpm run build || (echo '❌ Failed to build @ai-consultancy/lib' && exit 1)) && echo '✅ @ai-consultancy/lib built successfully' && echo '✅ All workspace packages built successfully'
